title: A Measure-Geometric Theory of Robustness in Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.33123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a foundational measure-geometric theory of robustness in machine learning. Robustness is formulated as escape from a retained task state relative to a reference measure on a data-bearing manifold, a perturbation gauge, and an admissible realization mechanism. The theory distinguishes the structural possibility of escape on the reference manifold from its ambient realization under mechanism-dependent observable readouts, while placing both within a unified geometric account. It introduces a mesoscopic organization of escape geometry, through which vulnerable mass, finite-scale morphology, delivered progress, and branch coherence are characterized by explicit laws as linked but non-identical robustness phenomena. By recasting robustness as the geometric formation, organization, realization, and persistence of escape, the theory provides a structural basis for analysis beyond scalar criteria.

translated_title: 机器学习中鲁棒性的测度几何理论
translated_abstract: 本文发展了一个机器学习鲁棒性的基础性测度几何理论。鲁棒性被表述为相对于承载数据的流形上的参考测度、一个扰动度规以及一个容许实现机制而言，从保持的任务状态中的逃逸。该理论区分了逃逸在参考流形上的结构性可能性与它在机制相关的可观测读数下的环境实现，同时将二者纳入统一的几何解释框架之中。它引入了逃逸几何的介观组织结构，通过这一结构，脆弱质量、有限尺度形态、传递的进展以及分支一致性以显式定律的方式被刻画为相互关联但不完全相同的鲁棒性现象。通过将鲁棒性重塑为逃逸的几何形成、组织、实现与持续，该理论为超越标量准则的分析提供了结构性基础。
tldr: 本文建立了机器学习鲁棒性的基础性测度几何理论，将鲁棒性重塑为逃逸的几何形成、组织、实现与持续过程，为超越标量准则的结构化鲁棒性分析奠定了基础。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a foundational measure-geometric theory of machine learning robustness, recasting robustness as the geometric formation, organization, realization, and persistence of escape, thereby providing a structural basis for analysis beyond scalar criteria.
